terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Rules that apply when using the BX-Connect community platform.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: BX-Connect, a Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL platform, supports the management of accounts, groups, activities, registrations, projects, messages, notifications and partner support.

sections.title: Account and access
sections.body: You must provide accurate information, protect your credentials and only use features authorised for your role. Attempting to access another user’s or group’s restricted data is prohibited.

sections.title: Conduct and content
sections.body: Exchanges must remain respectful and lawful. Harassment, discrimination, impersonation, illegal content, privacy violations and attacks against the platform are prohibited. You remain responsible for published content.

sections.title: Suspension and availability
sections.body: An account may be limited or disabled following a breach or security risk. BX-Connect aims to be reliable but cannot guarantee permanent availability.

sections.title: Applicable law and contact
sections.body: Belgian law applies. Questions may be sent to contact@bxconnect.be.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How BX-Connect processes your personal data in line with GDPR principles.

sections.title: Controller and data
sections.body: Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL, Brussels, processes identity and contact details, roles, groups, activities, registrations, projects, messages, notifications, support and evidence of legal acceptance.

sections.title: How data is used
sections.body: Data is used to manage and secure accounts, roles, groups, activities, registrations, projects, messages and notifications, process support, provide assistance and prevent abuse.

sections.title: Legal bases and recipients
sections.body: Processing relies on the requested service, consent, legal obligations or the association’s legitimate interest. Only authorised people and necessary providers receive access.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.body: Data is retained as needed, then deleted or anonymised unless a legal duty applies. Access controls, logs and backups reduce risks.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability where applicable. Contact: contact@bxconnect.be. You may complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority.

notices.title: Legal notice
notices.intro: Information about the publisher of the BX-Connect service.

sections.title: Publisher
sections.body: BX-Connect is published by Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL, Brussels, Belgium. Contact: contact@bxconnect.be.

sections.title: Publication responsibility
sections.body: Editorial responsibility is held by the administration of Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: Final production hosting details must be published before the service opens publicly.

sections.title: Intellectual property and reporting
sections.body: BX-Connect’s own materials are protected. Users retain rights to their content. Legal, security or data concerns may be reported to contact@bxconnect.be.
